verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a bulk or batch capability: no batch inference, no bulk repo edits, and no multi-item management operations. The CLI and library items show single actions only: uploading one file, listing models, running a job, and calling snapshot_download on a single repo with no stated bulk semantics. The OpenAPI and webhook items describe a general API surface, not a bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
